text:
I’m a passionate and hard-working data professional with 5 years of experience in SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization. I’m interested in your Smartsheet dashboard work and confident I can help you build clear, practical views for portfolio projects, bugs, and open helpdesk issues.

I’ve built reporting solutions that turn scattered information into something easy to track and act on. For Marlowe Furniture, I created a Sales KPI dashboard in Power BI using a star-schema model, replacing 14 separate Excel sales reports. That project streamlined monthly close reporting from 3 days to 4 hours. I also built an HR attrition dashboard for a manufacturing client, where each plant manager could only see their own plant’s data. That dashboard covered 1,900 employees and helped surface attrition hotspots in 2 plants.

For your Smartsheet needs, I can help design dashboards that are organized, readable, and useful for day-to-day management. I understand the importance of tracking project status, bugs, and support issues in a way that supports better communication and workflow visibility. Whether you need a portfolio dashboard to monitor multiple projects, a bug tracker dashboard to highlight priorities, or a helpdesk dashboard to keep open issues visible, I can structure the data and visuals so the right information stands out quickly.

My approach is to keep the dashboards simple, accurate, and easy to maintain. I’m comfortable working with data entry, cleaning, and reporting workflows, and I can help make sure the underlying information is organized properly so the dashboards stay reliable over time. I also value collaboration and clear communication, especially when dashboard requirements need to support project management and scheduling.

If you’re looking for someone who can build polished dashboards and make the data easier to manage, I’d be glad to help.
